title: MTrading
description: A secure and fully configurable trading system for player-to-player trades — perfect for SMPs and survival servers.
body:
# MTrading

MTrading brings a modern and scam-proof trading system to your Minecraft server!

With this plugin, players can safely trade with each other without worrying about scams or losing items. The system was specifically designed for SMPs, survival servers, and community projects.

Thanks to the clean GUI and secure confirmation system, trades are simple, fast, and reliable.

## Features

* Scam-proof trading system
* Player-to-player trading
* Modern GUI design
* Secure confirmation system
* Fully configurable
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Easy to use
* Stable and efficient code
* Customizable messages and settings

## Why MTrading?

* Perfect for SMPs and survival servers
* Prevents scams and item loss
* Modern and user-friendly design
* Encourages player trading
* Lightweight and performant
* Optimized for modern Minecraft versions

## Use Cases

* Player trading
* Community shops
* SMP economy systems
* Secure item trades
* Survival server trading

## Support
